source.evidence: Live capture, March 2014: enemy melee every 2.0 to 2.7 s (2300 ms used), a bigger hit at 1.5 times with effect 5622 against the normal 5409 (combat design 5.3).

Robgoblin Boomer bombs with burn ticks, Drone Fauzz's announced knock-down, Robgoblin Adept fire bursts at the player's feet, boss heavy hits that stun (combat evidence, enemies 4.2 and 4.3 rows 6, 15, 16).

(R) Every range, radius, multiplier, wind-up, flight time, animation and effect id below except the 2300 ms rhythm, the 1.5 special and effects 5409 / 5622: no original enemy attack table is recovered. `hit` multiplies the enemy's own normal hit.

adept_firebolt.note: (R) The Adept 'throws spells very fast'; fire lands at the player's feet.

big_slam.note: (R) The announcement is the telegraph's 3 s; the slam itself lands half a second after it starts.
